name: 1009-152-ptait09-claude-lane
note:
OVERSEER-EXECUTED, in blocked/: the fix is a .env edit on PTAIT09 plus a WINDOWS SERVICE restart, which a run on CT110 cannot reach. Paxton 2026-09-10. Source handoff docs/HANDOFF-ptait09-runner-claude-lane.md, ON ORIGIN as **5e8f15d**, the tip of branch easybutt0n-runner-v2, at docs/HANDOFF-ptait09-runner-claude-lane.md - VERIFIED by the overseer 21:25 PT (ls-remote tip + merge-base --is-ancestor + ls-tree). *** DO NOT look for 3b5042a: it is an ORPHANED local commit that is NOT on origin. The same handoff was re-committed and pushed as 5e8f15d; both carry the identical message, so they are easy to confuse. Reading the doc at 5e8f15d is correct. *** DEFECT (already diagnosed - do NOT re-derive): CLAUDE_PATH in the runner .env points at 'C:\Program Files
odejs\claude.cmd', which DOES NOT EXIST. claude actually lives at the SYSTEM-profile npm path (the service runs as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM). runner.js:43-73 resolveClaudePath() would find it, but CLAUDE_PATH_EXPLICIT short-circuits the probe when the var is set, so the bogus path goes straight to cmd.exe. Config drift, NOT a quoting bug - safeExe/winQuote are correct and the handoff reproduces the identical failure from a plain PowerShell prompt. FIX: delete the CLAUDE_PATH line and restart. *** RESTART THE WINDOWS SERVICE ptait09-runner, NOT pm2 - a pm2 daemon (pid 12764) also runs on that box but does NOT serve :7334, so restarting pm2 looks like it worked and changes nothing. *** Do NOT modify resolveClaudePath(); the probe is right, the config was wrong. bash/WSL stays broken BY DESIGN under LocalSystem - out of scope, not a regression. GATES TASK 153: until this is fixed the Cursor + Claude parallel QA lanes cannot run on ptait09.
